Name: Choose Your Geode
Author: ridwan12dvk
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Choose Your Geode[/b][/size]

Choose the reward you want and keep receiving it from every matching geode, treasure, or mystery box until you change or disable the selection.[/center]

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*]Choose from the natural reward pool of each supported container.[/*]
[*]Your selection remains active for every matching container until replaced or disabled.[/*]
[*]Only the selected container type is affected; other containers keep their normal random rewards.[/*]
[*]Supports bulk and automatic geode opening mods that use the vanilla reward system.[/*]
[*]Works when opening containers at Clint and supports the Geode Crusher.[/*]
[*]Filter rewards by All Rewards, items not yet found in Collections, or items not yet donated to the museum.[/*]
[*]Shows green indicators and tooltip details for incomplete Collection and museum entries.[/*]
[*]Preserves natural reward quantities instead of always giving one item.[/*]
[*]Each player has one separate active selection in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Includes English, Indonesian, and several other translations.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Supported Containers[/b]

[list]
[*]Geode[/*]
[*]Frozen Geode[/*]
[*]Magma Geode[/*]
[*]Omni Geode[/*]
[*]Artifact Trove[/*]
[*]Golden Coconut[/*]
[*]Mystery Box[/*]
[*]Golden Mystery Box[/*]
[/list]
[b]How To Use[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Keep a supported container in your inventory.[/*]
[*]Press [b]G[/b] to open the container menu.[/*]
[*]Select the container whose reward you want to control.[/*]
[*]Use the filter button if you only want to see undiscovered Collection items or undonated museum items.[/*]
[*]Choose a reward from the container's natural reward pool.[/*]
[*]Open one or many matching containers at Clint, through a compatible bulk-opening mod, or with a Geode Crusher.[/*]
[/list]
The selected reward remains active without a usage limit. For example, selecting [b]Frozen Tear[/b] for [b]Frozen Geode[/b] makes every Frozen Geode produce a Frozen Tear, while Magma Geodes, Omni Geodes, and other containers remain random.

Choosing a reward for another container replaces the previous active selection. Only one container-reward selection can be active per player.

[b]Disabling the Active Selection[/b]

Press [b]G[/b] and select [b]Disable Active Selection[/b] from the container menu. This option only appears when a selection is active.

The menu can still be opened to disable the selection even if you no longer have a supported container in your inventory.

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded ZIP.[/*]
[*]Place the [b]ChooseYourGeode[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]

The default menu key is [b]G[/b]. You can change it through Generic Mod Config Menu or by editing the mod's config file.

[b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]

[list]
[*]Single-player and multiplayer supported.[/*]
[*]Clint and Geode Crusher supported.[/*]
[*]Compatible with BreakGeodesInBulk and similar mods when they use Stardew Valley's vanilla geode reward function.[/*]
[*]No additional framework mods are required.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Current Limitations[/b]

[list]
[*]Only one container-reward selection can be active per player.[/*]
[*]The active selection resets when a save is loaded.[/*]
[*]Only the eight listed vanilla containers are officially supported.[/*]
[*]Custom containers and rewards added by other mods are not officially supported.[/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b]Support My Work[/b][/size]

If you enjoy this mod and would like to support future updates, you can buy me a coffee on Ko-fi.

[url=https://ko-fi.com/ridwan11dvk][b]Support me on Ko-fi[/b][/url][/center]

[b]Feedback and Bug Reports[/b]

When reporting an issue, please include your SMAPI log and describe the container, selected reward, opening method, and any bulk or automation mod involved.
